lines.text: Author'sProfile
Dr.DaniaQazi
Dr.Dania Qazi is a distinguished educator and prolific author with over two decades of
expertise in the field of education. From teaching and training to supervising and consulting,
her influence spans across all levels of education, from early years to Higher Education.
Dr.Dania has written over 70 educational textbooks and materials, which have been widely
used by schools in Pakistan and beyond. Her dedication to advancing educational discourse
is further evidenced by her extensive research contributions.Dr.Dania Qazi has authored and
presented numerous research papers, both domestically and internationally, covering a wide
spectrum of topics including education, leadership, management, and professional
development. Driven by a profound mission to enrich the lives of the young generation in
Pakistan. Dr. Dania Qazi is committed to providing quality education and instilling a
sustainable values system.
Rabia Sajad
Ms. Rabia Sajad is working in the education sector for the last twenty three years and has
served as an English Language Teacher, administrator, teacher trainer, curriculum developer
and an author. She holds a Masters Degree in English Language Teaching and an M.Phil
Degree in Education. Ms.Rabia Sajad has extensively worked in the field of curriculum
development and designs standards and assessment frameworks for language teaching. Her
unwavering passion and tireless efforts embody a steadfast commitment to shaping a
brighter future for generations to come.
